items: Title: Discovery / Earn-It Mechanics
Player Safe: Players can inspect, handle, keep, trade, reveal, or earn The Convenient Renewal when it is present in the fiction.
Gm Only: Use the roll only when the player's method, stakes, and consequence are concrete.

No Roll Reveals: Surface read: The ward "happens" to fail exactly as the village's protection contract comes up for renewal — at a generous new rate. Give obvious visible facts freely; roll for meaning, risk, leverage, cost, or a hidden angle.
